topics.topic: When a proven read-only flow version becomes a FlowActivation (automatic at compose/prove vs only via activate action)
questions: Does proving a read-only flow version during compose/prove automatically create a FlowActivation, or is activation created only when the activate action is called?
When exactly is a proven read-only flow version activated: automatically as part of compose-and-prove, or only when the activate-flow action is invoked?
Is activation of a proven read-only flow automatic at proof time, or does it occur only when someone calls the activate action?

quotes: A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven; any other flow only by the owner.

activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once; any other version only when the owner asks | active flow version | an unproven version is refused; an agent asking to activate a version with effects is refused and nothing is kept for the owner — the owner activates it by the same action |
judgement.why: One passage makes read-only activation happen once proof succeeds, while the other frames it as happening when the activate action is asked for.
